headline: Accor Upgrades Profit Outlook After Q3 RevPAR Climbs 4.9%
summary: Accor reported a 4.9% increase in revenue per available room (RevPAR) for the third quarter of 2026 and upgraded its full-year profit outlook.
why: Accor is a multinational hospitality company operating hotels worldwide. RevPAR and profit guidance upgrades reflect robust travel demand and pricing power across the hospitality sector.

impacts.name: Accor
impacts.why: Higher RevPAR and upgraded profit forecasts indicate stronger operational profitability and travel demand.

why_moved: Upgraded profit forecasts and higher room revenue metrics directly point to stronger-than-expected earnings potential, driving positive market sentiment.
